vllm-amd/generic:libtiff. libtiff bundled in the Pillow wheel (bundled-library scan, #811). vLLM decodes images only for a multimodal model's image inputs; the served model is text-only, and the API requires vLLM's key (held by LiteLLM). Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

vllm-amd/generic:openssl. OpenSSL linked statically into the cryptography wheel, found by the bundled-library scan (#811).
